To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the wear resistance of PTW filled epoxy composite is improved by addition of PTW, but the friction coefficient is increased.
PTW additions improve the wear resistance, hardness, and modulus of epoxy composites; however strength and ductility of composites decrease with the increasing PTW content.
the addition of PTW in epoxy matrix improved the tribological and mechanical properties of the composites.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of PTW content on mechanical and tribological properties of epoxy composites.
the tribological and mechanical characteristics of PTW filled epoxy composites.
the development of epoxy/PTWs composites with improved tribological properties.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the addition of PTW to epoxy resin is a viable method of improving the wear resistance of epoxy without significantly sacrificing the strength properties.
the addition of 10 wt% PTWs to epoxy is the optimum choice for achieving the desired properties.
addition of PTW in epoxy matrix improves wear resistance, stiffness properties, and hardness; however, tensile and flexural strength properties are reduced.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the addition of PTW to epoxy matrix improved the tribological and mechanical properties of the composites.
the addition of PTW to the epoxy matrix has a significant effect on wear resistance and friction coefficient.
PTW additions can be used to improve the wear and friction characteristics of epoxy resins, while maintaining good mechanical strength.
The main takeaway from our work is that
PTW reinforced epoxy composites could be used as potential candidate materials for tribological applications.
PTW can be considered as a potential reinforcing material for the fabrication of wear resistant epoxy composites.
the addition of PTW in the epoxy matrix improves the wear resistance of epoxy composites, but at the same time decreases the tensile properties of the composite.
